items.title: 8.1 Introduction to Online Research and Digital Literacy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter introduction and topic 8.1 (PDF 195), with short question 1 as a self-check.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter online research aur digital literacy ki basic baatein samjhata hai. Internet par maloomat ka bohat bara khazana hai; us mein se kaam ki cheez dhoondne aur sahi istemal karne ke liye yeh skills zaroori hain. Chapter mein online research ke aham tareeqe hain: advanced search techniques aur digital resources (internet par milne wali cheezein) ko sambhalna. Is ke ilawa yeh batata hai ke research ke wazeh sawal (research inquiries) kaise banayein, research ethics (research ke imandari wale usool) kya hain, aur intellectual property rights (apni soch se banayi cheezon par qanooni haq) ko kaise pehchanein. Yeh skills seekh kar students aur researchers mehnat se aur imandari se research kar sakte hain, aur digital content ka sahi istemal aur hifazat kar sakte hain.

Online research ka matlab hai internet par kisi khaas topic ke bare mein maloomat dhoondna. Is mein alag alag online sources (yani jahan se maloomat milti hai), jaise articles, reports ya videos, se ilm jama kiya jata hai. Online research ka maqsad aisi maloomat jama karna hai jo sahi, bharose ke qabil (trustworthy) aur taaza (current) ho, aur topic samajhne ya koi masla hal karne mein madad de. Online research karte waqt yeh dekhna zaroori hai ke maloomat kisi reliable source (bharose wali jagah) se aa rahi hai. Aise sources mein sarkari (government) websites, taleemi idare (educational institutions) ya mashhoor akhbar shamil hain. Kai sources ki maloomat aapas mein mila kar dekhne se yaqeen ho jata hai ke nateeje (findings) sahi hain.

blocks.prompt: Online research se mili maloomat ke reliable (bharose ke qabil) hone ka yaqeen kaise karein? (Short question 1)
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq: (1) dekhein ke maloomat reliable source se hai, jaise sarkari website, taleemi idara ya mashhoor akhbar; (2) kai sources ki maloomat aapas mein milayein (compare karein). Agar sab sources ek hi baat kahein to maloomat ke sahi hone ka yaqeen barh jata hai. Sath hi dekh lein ke content kis ne banaya (8.1.4, Evaluating Sources).

items: Online research: internet par kisi topic ki maloomat dhoondna (articles, reports, videos).
Maqsad: sahi, bharose ke qabil aur taaza maloomat.
Reliable sources: sarkari websites, taleemi idare, mashhoor akhbar; kai sources mila kar sachai jaanchein.
